# komodo_docker_registry_account (Resource)

Manages a Komodo docker registry account (credentials for accessing private image registries).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "komodo_docker_registry_account" "ghcr" {
  domain   = "ghcr.io"
  username = "my-github-user"
  token    = "ghp_…" # use var.* / a secret store in real configs (sensitive)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Registry domain without protocol (e.g. 'registry.hub.docker.com', 'ghcr.io'). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Personal access token or password for the registry account. Sensitive.
- `username` (String) Registry account username. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the docker registry account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing docker registry account by its Komodo ID.
terraform import komodo_docker_registry_account.ghcr 65a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1
```
